text:
Both responses are accurate. Neither misstates a date, number or condition: the 30-minute acceptance window, the 24/48-hour reminder choice set per clinic, the Android known issue and the next-month items are all correct.

The main difference is the 120-word limit, which both exceed. By my count, A is about 127 words and B about 133. A is closer to the limit but still over. B is easier to scan, but the extra length makes the violation larger.

On content, B names the tablet and invoice-printing fixes, while A only says "several bugs are fixed". These are minor details a busy manager would not miss. A keeps the main points in less space.

A's slight edge on length and concision is small, but accuracy is equal and the limit was an explicit instruction.

Verdict: A
